📝 Walkthrough ## Walkthrough This PR adds stdin control to subprocess helpers and updates Astro check execution to prefer project-local binaries, disable interactive behavior, and pass `subprocess.DEVNULL`. Tests cover platform-specific resolution, fallback behavior, environment settings, and timeouts. ### Changes **Non-interactive Astro check execution** | Layer / File(s) | Summary | |---|---| | **Subprocess stdin parameter infrastructure**
`lintro/plugins/base.py`, `lintro/plugins/subprocess_executor.py` | Subprocess helpers now accept and forward an optional `stdin` value through `subprocess.run`. | | **Astro check non-interactive execution and binary resolution**
`lintro/tools/definitions/astro_check.py` | Astro check resolves project-local `astro` binaries, including Windows `.cmd` files, before fallback commands. It passes the project cwd, sets `CI=1` and `ASTRO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1`, closes stdin with `subprocess.DEVNULL`, and expands timeout logging. | | **Non-interactive behavior and binary resolution tests**
`tests/unit/tools/astro_check/test_non_interactive.py` | Tests validate environment and stdin settings, local and platform-specific binary selection, fallback behavior, directory rejection, and timeout results. | **Estimated code review effort:** 3 (Moderate) | ~20 minutes ### Sequence Diagram(s) ```mermaid sequenceDiagram participant Check as astro_check.check() participant GetCmd as _get_astro_command participant LocalBin as _local_astro_binary participant Run as _run_subprocess Check->>GetCmd: _get_astro_command(cwd) GetCmd->>LocalBin: _local_astro_binary(cwd) LocalBin-->>GetCmd: local binary or fallback GetCmd-->>Check: selected command Check->>Run: _run_subprocess(cmd, env=..., stdin=DEVNULL) Run-->>Check: result or timeout ``` **Possibly related PRs** - [lgtm-hq/py-lintro#543](https://github.com/lgtm-hq/py-lintro/pull/543): Introduced the Astro check implementation extended here. - [lgtm-hq/py-lintro#1061](https://github.com/lgtm-hq/py-lintro/pull/1061): Refactored the subprocess helpers extended here with stdin forwarding. **Suggested labels:** `maintenance` **Poem** > A rabbit hops past prompts that stall, > Local Astro bins answer the call. > CI flags glow, stdin sleeps tight, > Windows shims resolve just right. > Checks race onward through the night.

title: _⚠️ Potential issue_ | _🟠 Major_ | _⚡ Quick win_
body:
_⚠️ Potential issue_ | _🟠 Major_ | _⚡ Quick win_

**Normalize Windows local binary command path before subprocess validation.**

On Line 146, `str(local_astro)` yields backslashes on Windows (e.g., `C:\...\astro.cmd`). That command is later rejected by command validation, so the local-binary path fails before execution.

 
<details>
<summary>Proposed fix</summary>

```diff
         if cwd is not None:
             local_astro = _local_astro_binary(cwd)
             if local_astro is not None:
-                return [str(local_astro), "check"]
+                local_cmd = str(local_astro)
+                if sys.platform == "win32":
+                    # Keep command validator compatibility (no backslashes in cmd[0])
+                    local_cmd = local_cmd.replace("\\", "/")
+                return [local_cmd, "check"]
```
</details>


Also applies to: 362-363

<details>
<summary>🤖 Prompt for AI Agents</summary>

```
Verify each finding against current code. Fix only still-valid issues, skip the
rest with a brief reason, keep changes minimal, and validate.

In `@lintro/tools/definitions/astro_check.py` around lines 143 - 147, The local
Windows binary path returned by _local_astro_binary is converted with
str(local_astro) which preserves backslashes and later fails command validation;
change the return to normalize the Path to POSIX form (e.g., use
local_astro.as_posix()) so the command uses forward slashes, and apply the same
change where a local astro path is returned elsewhere (the other occurrence
around lines 362-363) to ensure subprocess validation accepts the path.
```

</details>

title: _🛠️ Refactor suggestion_ | _🟠 Major_ | _⚡ Quick win_
body:
_🛠️ Refactor suggestion_ | _🟠 Major_ | _⚡ Quick win_

**Add one non-mocked path-validation test for Windows local binary commands.**

These tests mock `_run_subprocess`, so command validation is never exercised. Add one focused test that goes through `run_subprocess` (or directly `validate_subprocess_command`) with a Windows-style local `astro.cmd` path to lock this boundary down.

 


Also applies to: 93-94, 127-129, 164-166, 196-198, 224-226, 245-250

<details>
<summary>🤖 Prompt for AI Agents</summary>

```
Verify each finding against current code. Fix only still-valid issues, skip the
rest with a brief reason, keep changes minimal, and validate.

In `@tests/unit/tools/astro_check/test_non_interactive.py` around lines 62 - 63,
Add a new unit test in tests/unit/tools/astro_check/test_non_interactive.py that
does not patch astro_check_plugin._run_subprocess and instead calls
astro_check_plugin.validate_subprocess_command (or
astro_check_plugin.run_subprocess) with a Windows-style local binary path (e.g.,
r"C:\some\dir\astro.cmd" or ".\\astro.cmd") to verify the command validation
logic for local .cmd executables; ensure the test constructs the same arguments
used by existing tests (use the same project fixture or argv shape), asserts the
expected return/exception for a non-executed local command, and only mocks
external side effects (like process spawn) if absolutely needed so the code path
in validate_subprocess_command/run_subprocess is exercised.
```

</details>
